item.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.

item.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Startup Battlefield 200: Celebrating outstanding achievements
item.dc:creator: Michael Schick, Isabelle Johannessen
item.description: Among the Startup Battlefield 200 were many industry-defining companies exhibiting and pitching on the Showcase Stage. Here are the standouts.

item.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.

item.title: Tesla is prepping a Cybercab onslaught
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The company is looking to roll out the gold two-seater robotaxis to other U.S. cities this year, even as it goes mum on the number of paid rides.

item.title: Spotify confirms Family Plan crackdown, but calls it a ‘routine improvement’
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Spotify told investors its rollout of QR code verification to ensure Family Plan members live in the same household is not a "crackdown," just a routine improvement.

item.title: Investors break down how founders can raise a Series A today
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Raising a Series A these days isn't so simple — top investors break down what founders need to know now.

item.title: Spotify’s current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explains why the rise of AI agents could be good news for the music service.

item.title: Fusion startup Helion is developing new semiconductors that could double output of its power plants
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Helion now has another $225 million to help speed development of its first fusion power plant, due to provide Microsoft with electricity in 2028.

item.title: Developer platform Railway urges ‘all users’ to revoke secret keys after cyberattack
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The vibe-coding platform said all of its customers should revoke and rotate their private keys, after hackers were able to decrypt some customer secrets.

item.title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Claude Duet is available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users.

item.title: Nirva raises $33M for a pendant that only listens to you
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Nirva will ship its $249 ambient AI pendant by the end of the year.

item.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns.

item.title: Tesla says it will start selling Cybercabs by end of year
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: There is at least one obstacle that could throw off Tesla's Cybercab fleet plans. The NHTSA announced last month that it had opened an investigation into the Cybercab, just hours after the vehicles began operating on public streets in Austin.

item.title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters.

item.title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The social media giant is planning a new stock strategy to help power its broad investments in AI models and services.

item.title: Airbnb limits chores for guests, sparking backlash from hosts
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Hosts are threatening to leave the platform after Airbnb says that they can no longer require guests to strip beds or do other time-consuming cleaning chores.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

item.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during its Q3 earnings call. The AI app now has over 10M users.

item.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Just 9 months after raising a $180 million seed round, Flapping Airplanes has landed a $1 billion Series A for its mission to build AI models "without ingesting half the internet."

item.title: Tesla starts Optimus robot production in California as profit falls 43%
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec, Sean O'Kane
item.description: Tesla's revenue was flat and its expenses skyrocketed as it pressed the accelerator on its Optimus robots, AI, and autonomous driving.
